correctness.rationale: Every automorphism monomial by independence of basis squares. Pairwise-local map basis images form one permutation; matching each basis vector with an arbitrary x forces one monomial linear map. Matching e_i with its square enforces multiplicativity on squares, and mixed basis products are zero. This covers any field, all finite dimensions, and nonlinear inputs; exhaustive F2 checks corroborate.

value.rationale: A complete all-dimensional and all-fields local-to-global theorem for nonlinear two-local automorphisms of perfect evolution algebras. It eliminates potential exotic two-local symmetries for a structural class of genetic/nonassociative algebras, contrasting with the richer nilpotent local-operator setting. It is a motivated uniform classification rather than a finite special-case recomputation.
